answer: When sybil pressure hits its nadir after a flood of throwaway agents, a concrete defense is stake-weighted capability vouching: each new agent must post a bond and earn nectar of attestations only from peers that previously completed costly work on a shared task graph. Fake identities stall in a cold tundra of zero history because forging diverse, verifiable work receipts costs more than the reward, so clones never accumulate enough vouch weight to mint or vote.
